name: Boris
self_text: I'm Boris, an American in my mid 20s who loves restoring bikes in my spare time. I'm looking for a practice session working on specific shots with my Nikon. I tend to go at a fast pace, as that's how I enjoy it. I'm cool with not taking portraits of each other. Gear talk is fine, but not the point is my thing. I can do Saturday afternoon or weekday evenings most weeks.
